blueprint.title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
blueprint.description: Offer internet packages based on the user's residential address and set up the selected offer.
blueprint.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
bbk = GetBBKByAddress(User.Address)
inventory = GetInventory(bbk)
IF inventory.Available == TRUE THEN
    products = GetProductBySpeed()
    selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection(products)
    PortAllocation(selectedProduct.serial_number)
    MessageUser()
    Configuration(selectedProduct.serial_number)
    PortConnection(selectedProduct.assignment_id)
END_IF
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

blueprint.title: Order and Compliance
blueprint.description: Find product, assign compliance certificate, create purchase order, write process to LLM, and send email.

parameters.question: Which product would you like to order?

properties.description: Ask user to select a product
Search and retrieve the product details
Assign a compliance certificate to the product
Create a Purchase Order for the certified product
Write and summarize the order process using LLM
Send email notification about the completed purchase order

content: Process an order with compliance certificate check.
pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection()
product = FindProduct(selectedProduct)
AssignCertificate(product.id)
PO.Create(product.id)
LLM.WriteProcess()
Email.Send()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE
